issues.display_title: Issue #25: Fix Issue Thumbnail Navigation Scroll Position Resets on Refresh
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by developer

2026-06-26.17-11-07.mp4

A UX issue has been reported in the newer version regarding the image thumbnails and the navigation section. When the thumbnails or navigation section refreshes, the user's scroll position is not preserved, and the view jumps back up to the top.

This creates a frustrating and unfriendly experience, especially when navigating through a large batch of stitched images.

Sub task:

  • Preview
  • File Manager
  • Edit

Acceptance Criteria

  1. The image thumbnails and navigation section can refresh or update state without resetting the user's scroll position.
  2. The user experience feels smooth and stable when interacting with the thumbnail navigation panel.

QA Tester Summary - 2026-07-06

QA Decision

Failed.

Issue #25 is not fully resolved because the Edit thumbnail/navigation panel still changes scroll position after a same-directory refresh/update. Preview and File Manager source contracts look correct for the tested paths, but Edit still violates the acceptance criteria.

Test Scenario & Result

ID Scenario Result Notes
TC1 Preview thumbnail/navigation refresh preserves scroll position. Passed Source contract saves current scrollTop for same-directory reload and restores it after layout. Real-app measurement preserved 5272 -> 5272.
TC2 File Manager thumbnail/navigation refresh does not reset to top except on actual directory change. Passed with scope note Source contract resets scrollTop = 0 only when prevDir !== currentDir. Real-app selector capture for File Manager was inconclusive, so decision uses source-contract evidence for this sub-task.
TC3 Edit thumbnail/navigation refresh does not re-center or jump during ordinary state updates. Failed src/renderer/components/features/Edit/Browse.tsx still increments triggerJumpToActive during same-directory refresh when lastActiveImage exists, causing the active-item jump effect to run as an explicit center jump. Real-app measurement changed 5272 -> 3897 after refresh.
TC4 Large-list harness validates expected scroll-preservation behavior across Preview/File Manager/Edit. Passed Harness confirms the expected contract: same-directory refresh should preserve scroll and should not jump to top or active row.

Code / Response Review

Area Path QA Review
Preview src/renderer/components/features/Preview/Browse.tsx Syntax valid. Same-directory reload stores prevScrollPositionRef and restores scrollRef.current.scrollTop; active jump uses align: isExplicitJump ? 'center' : 'auto'.
File Manager src/renderer/components/features/FileManager/Browse.tsx Syntax valid. scrollTop = 0 is gated by prevDir !== currentDir, which is acceptable for actual folder navigation and should not trigger on ordinary same-directory refresh.
Edit src/renderer/components/features/Edit/Browse.tsx Syntax valid but behavior is wrong for issue #25. loadEffect calls setTriggerJumpToActive((prev) => prev + 1) when lastActiveImage exists; the active jump effect treats that as explicit and calls rowVirtualizer.scrollToIndex(..., { align: 'center' }).
QA regression coverage qa-testing/automation/e2e/module/navigation/issue-25-thumbnail-navigation-scroll-preservation.spec.ts Added focused regression coverage for Preview, File Manager, Edit, and a gray-box large-list scroll harness. Current result: 3 passed, 1 failed.

Bugs / Issues Found

Severity Bug Evidence
Major Edit thumbnail/navigation scroll is not preserved on same-directory refresh/update. The panel moves from the user's manual scroll position back toward the selected/active item. Automated TC3 fails; real-app measurement on fixture C:\Users\Work\Test GoThru Photo Studio\COUNTER changed scrollTop from 5272 to 3897 after refresh.

No HTTP/backend 500 was observed in this issue path.

Evidence

Evidence Result
qa-testing\scripts\playwright-local.cmd test --config qa-testing\automation\e2e\playwright.config.ts --grep @issue-25 3 passed, 1 failed
npm.cmd run typecheck Passed, tsc --noEmit exit 0
Real-app Preview measurement Passed: scrollTop 5272 -> 5272
Real-app Edit measurement Failed: scrollTop 5272 -> 3897
Real-app video Captured from fresh installed app launch after killing previous process

QA Notes

  • The failure is recorded in this issue summary only. No new GitHub issue/task/card was created.
  • File Manager real-app selector measurement did not locate the intended scroll container in this run, so File Manager remains source-contract verified rather than black-box measured.

Uploaded Screenshots

Real app Preview after refresh; measured scrollTop preserved 5272 -> 5272.

Real app Edit after refresh; measured scrollTop changed 5272 -> 3897, confirming unstable thumbnail scroll.

Video frame check from real-app scroll refresh recording.

issues.display_title: Issue #11: Handle Enfuse Process Interruption on Screen Navigation
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by developer

2026-06-23.17-54-08.mp4

Description

An issue has been reported where the Enfuse process halts or stops working if the user navigates away from the active screen.

Crucial Requirement: As explicitly requested, all investigations and implementations for this issue must be done exclusively on the new Rust + Tauri build. Do not apply this to the old legacy build (Electron).

We need to address this either by fixing the underlying architecture so it runs in the background, or by implementing a preventative UX measure to warn the user.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. The code changes are implemented strictly on the new Rust + Tauri repository.
  2. Either the Enfuse process successfully continues running in the background when the user navigates to a different screen, OR a clear warning modal is displayed preventing the user from accidentally leaving the screen and interrupting the task.

QA Tester Summary

Issue: #11 - Handle Enfuse Process Interruption on Screen Navigation
QA Date: 2026-07-06
Build / Target: GoThru Photo Studio Tauri repo, installed-app config version 1.1.2
Decision: Failed - major acceptance gap found

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Expected Result
TC1 White Box Verify Enfuse is implemented on the Rust + Tauri path, not legacy Electron enfuse-files, cancel, and overwrite-check are registered through Tauri/Rust state Passed
TC2 White Box Navigate away from Enfuse while processing is possible App blocks the navigation or shows a clear warning modal Failed
TC3 Gray Box Background Enfuse queue survives Enfuse screen unmount Queue processing/status is controlled by a persistent background service or resumable backend state Failed

Code / Response Review

Area Source Path Review
Rust Enfuse command src-tauri/src/commands/enfuse.rs Passed: enfuse_files is a Tauri command and uses tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking; cancellation uses EnfuseState and removes partial output on cancel.
Tauri registration src-tauri/src/lib.rs Passed: app.manage(enfuse::EnfuseState::default()), enfuse::enfuse_files, and enfuse::cancel_process_enfuse_files are registered.
Renderer bridge src/lib/electron-bridge.ts Passed: renderer maps enfuseFiles, cancelProcessEnfuseFiles, and checkEnfuseOverwrite to the Tauri command names.
Enfuse navigation guard src/renderer/components/features/Edit/Enfuse/Content.tsx Failed: the back action directly calls dispatch(setEditMenu(null)); no processing check, warning modal, confirm dialog, or prevent-navigation path was found.
Enfuse screen lifecycle src/renderer/components/features/Edit/Edit.tsx Failed: layout.editMenu controls whether <EnfuseContent /> is mounted; leaving Enfuse unmounts the active Enfuse UI.
Enfuse queue controller src/renderer/components/features/Edit/Enfuse/ProgressList.tsx, src/renderer/components/features/Edit/Enfuse/hooks/useEnfuseProcess.ts Failed: useEnfuseProcess() is mounted from ProgressList; queue continuation (if (nextLog) processing(nextLog)) is hook-local and not exposed as a persistent background queue service or backend resume state.

Bugs / Issues Found

Severity Bug Evidence
Major Acceptance path #2 is not implemented: user can leave Enfuse with a direct setEditMenu(null) back action and no clear warning modal/prevention while processing may be active. Content.tsx:56; Playwright TC2 failed.
Major Acceptance path #1 is not proven/reliable for the full queue: Rust child process can keep running, but renderer queue orchestration and next-item continuation are component/hook-local. When Enfuse screen is unmounted, there is no persistent controller or backend queue state to guarantee user-visible processing/status recovery. Edit.tsx:215-278, ProgressList.tsx:44, useEnfuseProcess.ts:60-61; Playwright TC3 failed.

Backend Status Code / Response Notes

Check Result
In-scope HTTP/API response code review Not applicable for this Enfuse navigation path; no HTTP/backend request flow was exercised by the issue acceptance test.
HTTP 500 found No. No in-scope HTTP 500 was observed.
Tauri command response contract Reviewed via source. Enfuse returns JSON status values (success, canceled, failed) rather than HTTP status codes.

Evidence

Evidence Result
Automation spec qa-testing/automation/e2e/module/edit/enfuse/issue-11-enfuse-navigation-interruption.spec.ts
Playwright command qa-testing\scripts\playwright-local.cmd test --config qa-testing\automation\e2e\playwright.config.ts --grep @issue-11
Playwright result 1 passed, 2 failed. TC1 passed; TC2 and TC3 failed on acceptance requirements.
TypeScript check npm.cmd run typecheck passed.
Screenshot evidence issue-11-handle-enfuse-process-interruption-startup.png, issue-11-handle-enfuse-process-interruption-enfuse-panel.png, issue-11-handle-enfuse-process-interruption-after-navigation.png
Video evidence issue-11-handle-enfuse-process-interruption-on-screen-navigation.mp4
Visual evidence note The installed app evidence shows the Enfuse panel and the back-navigation result: the app returns to the Edit tool menu without a visible warning/confirm modal.

QA Decision

Failed. The Rust/Tauri backend portion exists, but the issue acceptance is not satisfied end-to-end. The app currently has neither a clear warning modal preventing accidental navigation away from active Enfuse processing nor a persistent/background queue controller that guarantees reliable continuation and status recovery after the Enfuse screen unmounts.

issues.display_title: Issue #24: Fix build ships cross-platform binaries (Win & Mac mixed)
issues.main_description_html:
Problem:
Builds ship binaries for all platforms. The Windows build also includes
Mac binaries, and the Mac build also includes Windows binaries. As a
result, installers get bigger and contain files that are not used on
that OS.

Expected:
The Windows build should only ship Windows binaries. The Mac build
should only ship Mac binaries.

Solution:
Separate the binary settings per platform so each build only picks up
the matching folder.

Acceptance criteria:

  • Windows installer contains Windows binaries only.
  • Mac installer contains Mac binaries only.
  • All features that use binaries (exiftool, enfuse, etc.) still work
    normally on each OS.
  • Installer size is reduced.

issues.display_title: Issue #17: Fix panorama switching when play pano on Preview
issues.main_description_html:
Fix Panorama Switching When Play Pano on Preview

Summary

When the user enables Play (auto-rotate slideshow) on a panorama in Preview, the app should automatically advance to the next image panorama after each rotation interval. .pts files and videos must be skipped during autoplay so the slideshow never stalls on non-viewable items.

Problem

Expected behavior: With Play enabled (layout.isAutoRotate), the viewer spins the current panorama, then advances to the next image file after rotationDuration seconds. .pts tour files and videos are bypassed. Autoplay stops when there are no more images ahead.

Current behavior:

Component Issue
Main.tsx autoplay timer Fires synthetic ArrowRight every rotationDuration ms via triggerRightArrow()
Preview.tsx keyboard nav getNextFile / getPreviousFile walk the full merged list [...images, ...regularFiles] with no skip logic
.pts files Listed in regularFiles (type: 'file'). Selecting one clears the viewer and shows the banner — slideshow appears stuck
Videos Listed in images (type: 'video'). Sphere autorotate is disabled for video (autorotate={!isVideo && layout.isAutoRotate}), but autoplay still lands on them and breaks the pano slideshow flow

User-visible symptoms:

  1. Slideshow stops on .pts — autoplay advances to a .pts file, viewer goes blank/banner, rotation interval keeps firing but no panorama is shown.
  2. Slideshow hits videos — autoplay lands on video files instead of continuing through image panoramas only.
  3. Toolbar next/prev during Play — left/right buttons dispatch the same ArrowRight/ArrowLeft events, so they share the same bug when autoplay is active.

Goals

Fix panorama file switching during Play so only image panoramas are visited.

Navigation logic

  • Add findNextImageFile / findPreviousImageFile helpers that scan the merged list and return only items with type === 'image'
  • When layout.isAutoRotate is true, ArrowRight / ArrowLeft (and D / A keys) use the skip helpers instead of getNextFile / getPreviousFile
  • When no next image exists, dispatch SET_AUTO_ROTATE with isAutoRotate: false (stop Play)
  • Manual navigation (Play off) unchanged — arrow keys still move through all file types including .pts and video

UI / UX

  • Play slideshow cycles through image panoramas only, respecting folder sort order (images + .pts interleaved in browse, but .pts skipped in slideshow)
  • Play stops cleanly at the last image (pause icon, no blank viewer)
  • Toolbar prev/next buttons behave correctly while Play is active

Out of scope

  • Changing manual (non-autoplay) keyboard or mouse navigation behavior
  • Autoplay for 360° videos as a separate slideshow mode
  • File Manager / Edit browse navigation

Technical flow

User clicks Play (isAutoRotate = true)
  → Main.tsx setInterval → triggerRightArrow()
    → synthetic keydown ArrowRight
      → Preview.tsx handleArrowKeys
        → [FIX] findNextImageFile(items, index)  // skip video + .pts
          → selectDisplayItem(next image)
  → Panorama autorotate on current image
  → repeat until no next image → SET_AUTO_ROTATE false

Key files:

  • src/renderer/components/features/Preview/Preview.tsx — arrow-key navigation, handleArrowKeys
  • src/renderer/components/features/Preview/Main.tsx — Play toggle, autoplay interval, triggerRightArrow / triggerLeftArrow

Test plan

  • Folder with mixed files: IMG_1.jpg, tour.pts, IMG_2.jpg, video.mp4, IMG_3.jpg (natural sort order)
  • Open IMG_1.jpg → enable Play → after interval advances to IMG_2.jpg (skips .pts)
  • Continue Play → advances to IMG_3.jpg (skips video)
  • On last image, Play stops automatically (no blank viewer, pause icon shown)
  • Disable Play → ArrowRight manually selects .pts and video as before
  • Toolbar next/prev while Play is on skips .pts and video the same way
  • Folder with only .pts and videos → Play stops immediately or does not advance to non-images
  • Regression: WASD / arrow grid jump (Up/Down) unchanged when Play is off

issues.main_description_html:
Define the App Name and Version Display Rules

Docs

Specs

app-version-placement.md

Plan

2026-06-24-app-version-placement.md

Context

The app currently shows the version beside the first app/menu label. The intended behavior is to keep the menu label clean and move the version into the app/window title.

Goal

Create one clear rule for how the app name appears in menus and one clear rule for how the app title appears with the version.

What We're Building

A shared display rule where:

  • Menu label shows GoThru Photo Studio.
  • Window title shows GoThru Photo Studio <version>.

File Involved

  • src-tauri/src/commands/app_menu.rs

Acceptance Criteria

  • The menu label does not include any version number.
  • The window title format includes the current app version.
  • The version value comes from the app's existing version information.
  • Future version changes do not require manually editing menu text.

What Changes After This Task

The app has a single agreed rule for product name and version display, reducing the chance that different parts of the app show different labels.
